author: Koehler, 1914

note.en: A small banded brittle star of shallow rubble, known here from museum specimens. Disc size is an approximate field-guide value.
note.es: Una ofiura anillada pequeña del escombro somero, conocida aquí por especímenes de museo. El tamaño del disco es un valor aproximado de guías de campo.

evidence: GBIF: 4 records in the region (many are museum specimens)

sources.t: WoRMS: World Register of Marine Species, accepted name and range

recWhy: Recorded: GBIF: 4 records in the region (many are museum specimens).

photos.by: Gondim AI, Alonso C, Dias TLP, Manso CLC, Christoffersen ML (2013) A taxonomic guide to the brittlestars(Echinodermata, Ophiuroidea) from the State of Paraíba continental shelf, Northeastern Brazil. ZooKeys 307: 45–96. doi: 10.3897/zookeys.307.4673

marks.en: Slim brittle star with long arms banded in brown and white.
marks.es: Ofiura delgada de brazos largos anillados en pardo y blanco.
